mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 3.5% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days, reflecting improved labor market conditions and investor confidence.
failure_condition: 20d returns fail to be positive when UNRATE crosses below 3.5%, or the drop in UNRATE is not sustained for at least 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in demand (GDPC1) and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) creates a positive feedback loop, driving S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising GDPC1 and falling FEDFUNDS does not correlate with positive returns over 60 days, or the proxies move in opposite directions more frequently than expected.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 20 trading days as higher interest rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: Positive 20d returns occur in > 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS rises, or FEDFUNDS do not exhibit a clear tightening trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in demand (GDPC1) above 200 billion chained 2017 dollars triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, signaling robust economic activity.
failure_condition: 20d returns fail to be positive when GDPC1 crosses above 200, or the increase is not sustained for at least 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as businesses expand output.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not correlate with positive returns over 60 days, or the supply-side indicators show no upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and labor participation (PAYEMS) drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting broad economic strength.
failure_condition: The co-movement of GDPC1 and PAYEMS does not predict positive returns over 20 days, or the proxies move inversely more frequently than expected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% during a labor market recovery regime triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, boosting investor sentiment.
failure_condition: 20d returns fail to be positive when UNRATE crosses below 3.5%, or the recovery is not sustained for 60 days.
